notes.title: Bookshop Simulator Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Bookshop Simulator has released into early access. We apologize for the delay, and we thank our community for enduring the wait with us. We appreciate the support and understanding.  Join our Discord server to tell us what you think about the game! We are closely following and engaging with our community to make Bookshop Simulator the best game it can be!  Discord - [url="https://discord.gg/MgyQGBGwRN"]https://discord.gg/MgyQGBGwRN[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We began this project back in October 2024 after being laid off from our day jobs in the game industry. We love the job sim genre, and we wanted to make something in that genre that we would want to play. We have many more things we want to add to the game and we can't wait to see people playing it![/p][p][/p][p]-Alex, Ian, and Zach[/p]

notes.title: Bookshop Simulator Early Access Release Date
notes.notes: [p]We are ready to announce that Bookshop Simulator will launch in Early Access on Steam on September 12th. We would like to thank everyone who played the demo and joined the Blep Games Discord. Your support and feedback has helped us immensely to prepare for our launch, but this is just the beginning! We plan to use Early Access as a limited window of further development to add more features and variety to the game. Add Bookshop Simulator to your Wishlist today and join us on this journey![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557937/aa69c9346c7a87edfe78d71bcb00dabf28f79efc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Feature Sneak Peak: Furniture Painter
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Today we're going to share a sneak peak at one of the features that will be in the game from the start - the Furniture Painter! We want to give everyone some fairly easy customization options to really make your bookstore feel like your own. This handy spray paint will allow you to change the color of most furniture to some different options. For bookcases, this includes different wood materials and painted varieties. Here's a quick gif on it in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557937/dc4c08c300edf5d2296e82a9f9b100cb6c0dc76f.gif[/img]

Once you've bought the Furniture Painter, which is available in the Bookshop Depot app alongside wall and flooring customization options, you may freely change materials on any applicable furniture free of cost to fit whatever style you're going for! The Furniture Painter can change the materials on bookshelves, rugs, checkout counters, indoor trash cans, and more!

The Furniture Painter is now live in the demo and can be played around with right now!
